name: resolve-signed-workspace-gap-bindings-only
title: Resolve signed-workspace gaps and gitRoot repair UX
description: Resolve the signed-workspace gap_analyze bindings and add deterministic gitRoot diagnostic/repair UX for wrapper-root projects where metadata root is not git-backed but a nested child repo is the intended signed workspace. Keep the fix host-neutral: Lattice CLI diagnoses and performs an explicit confirmed config write; Claude/Codex hosts do not silently auto-repair, choose repositories, or override policy.
